Just about anywhere you specify the drone NUMBER you can use the drone NAME, instead.

For example:
	navigate John r5

Note that while the names do NOT auto-complete, you can use partial names, as well:
	gather Jo all
Don't rely on Motion Sensor exclusively for exploration. Many other upgrades can be used by themselves or in tandem to safely explore derelicts
In the options there are MANY difficulty options. Try adjusting some settings to make the game easier till you get the hang of things
It is a bad idea to open a door if you don't know if there are threats on the other side. There's another way to explore, take a moment to think it through
Take what you need and run. Trying to explore that last room might net you some scrap, or a fleet of dead drones.
There are several ways to skulk about a ship, rarely is confronting a threat a good move.
Different ship types/classes/ages have different tendencies, both in terms of risks and rewards. Pay attention and let that help you choose which ship to board
The first room (and adjoining rooms with open doors) are safe initially and don't contain threats. Initially.
Your docking bay can be used for more than cold storage, aided by the right upgrades.

Threats all behave differently. By learning their 'tells' and paying attention to the number of infestation types, you can deduce which are aboard. In turn you'll know, say, if it's safe to be in a room with a vent or not...

Commandeering a ship can not only net you more ship upgrades (those permanently and securely installed), but more ship upgrade slots, scrap capacity (listed on system map or with 'status' command), fuel capacity (use 'info' command on fuel access point), and certain specialized ship upgrades. Likewise ships wear over time (see 'Ship Wear') and start to malfunction so keep an eye out for signs of wear (ship slots & ship schematic video feed).
Some scrap can only be revealed by scanning
Upgrades take wear upon initial activation during a mission. So if you don't use an upgrade it will not wear, and after initial use on a mission, additional uses do not cause significant wear.

Your ship will wear over time. Ship upgrade slots will deteriorate, as will the schematic view video feed. Commandeering another vessel is recommended as the new vessel will have less wear, and repairing slots and ship video feed can be cost prohibitive.

Semicolons can be used to execute more than one command on a single command line.  Example:

> open d5; navigate 1 r4; navigate 3 r7

Commands issued to the same drone will get executed serially (one after another). Other commands will execute in parallel (at the same time)

Use arrow keys to pilot drone 1

Pilot the drone into the derelict ship (through airlock a1)

You found a POWER INLET. 

Notice how Drone 2 has a GENERATOR in it's list of Upgrades (upper left corner of screen). 

Type 'generator'

Switch to the Schematic View with SPACE to see what rooms are powered.

You can now operate the newly powered doors, however never open doors to unknown rooms.

Type 'navigate 1 r3' to send Drone 1 to Room 3
